description: Checks tools/quality/portal2_paint.py applies to a build capture of this workload, each against the retail reference (reference.json). A measure rule compares one QA_MEASURE number; a region rule compares one shot region's pixel class fraction or mean colour. Regions are [x0, y0, x1, y1] in the 1024x768 frame. Classes: blue, orange (repulsion/propulsion gel as lit on screen), white (conversion gel: neutral grey, chroma < 14, luma > 80), gel (blue or orange).

measures.defect: repulsion gel does not bounce the player: the engine paint map is missing, so SphereTracePaintSurface finds no paint
propulsion gel does not speed the player up
walking speed off propulsion gel differs from retail (control)
water does not remove repulsion gel
a portal was placed on the unpainted, non-portal wall (control)
conversion gel does not accept a portal

regions.defect: the map's repulsion gel is not drawn on the trench floor
painted floor colour differs from retail's (paint shader, lighting)
propulsion gel from a sprayer is not drawn on the floor
propulsion gel colour differs from retail's
water does not erase drawn gel (or gel is missing around the patch)
the patch water later erases was not painted
conversion gel is not drawn on the end wall
